brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.

requirements.evidence: Single cell at 0,0,0: piece:0,0,0;full base with cover:0,0,0;full;top on top and 6 solid caps (caps at 30°,90°,150°,210°,270°,330°) enclosing all side faces. check_build meshClash=clear, no open-face errors.

requirements.requirement: Louvred vent so board can breathe
requirements.evidence: port:0#0,0#0 hex-port-louvre installed in slot 0 at 0,0,0. Part is designed to vent a closed cell without letting rain in.
bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-third-pi - third-depth tray with Raspberry Pi mounting posts providing standoffs for board inside enclosed cell, sits under cover within caps.

finish.summary: Built a sealed single-cell enclosure: full base + full top cover + 6 solid caps for closed sides, with one hex-port-louvre for ventilation, and a Pi-post bin inside to carry the board. Mesh check clear.
